title: Manual door unlock (§6-8)
description: Release a stuck door lock before or during service — power must be disconnected first.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Washer (Job Aid L-78)

steps.title: Manually unlock the door lock system
steps.body:
1. Unplug washer or disconnect power.
2. Remove the lower kick panel.
3. Reach up along the inside of the front and locate the bottom of the door switch/lock unit.
4. On the bottom of the lock is a teardrop-shaped tab.
5. Gently pull the tab down about ¼″ until a click is heard.
6. The door may be opened.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manually Unlocking the Door Lock System — §6-8.
